source: NF4 uses 16 representable codebook values chosen from quantiles of a normal distribution and normalized into a bounded range. A stored 4-bit value is therefore an index into this codebook. It is not a conventional floating-point encoding with sign, exponent, and mantissa fields.
zh: NF4 使用从正态分布的分位数中选择的 16 个可表示的码本值，并将其标准化为有界范围。因此，存储的 4 位值是该码本的索引。它不是带有符号、指数和尾数字段的传统浮点编码。
